customManagers.description: Claude Code CLI pinned in the Dockerfile's npm install. config:recommended's dockerfile manager only reads FROM lines, so an `npm install -g pkg@version` inside a RUN is invisible to it -- this pin sat at 2.1.220 while the rest of the fleet moved to 2.1.251, and nothing would ever have opened a PR for it. The Dockerfile comment already said 'bump both together', which no bot can read. Mirrors the identical manager in Dezoxy/my-health-datas. The application image pin is separate from the global homelab CLI; verify subscription and editorial behavior on a new migration CLI during the cloud pilot.

The Azure image pin, infra/azure/image.auto.tfvars.json. No built-in manager reads a Terraform tfvars JSON file, so this extracts the exact X.Y.Z tag of the application image. The homelab repo tracks this same private GHCR image with the docker datasource.

packageRules.description: twifork IS tracked, but gated behind the Dependency Dashboard rather than opening a PR on its own. It is a single-maintainer fork of the dead upstream twikit, it still imports as `twikit`, and it handles a live X session cookie -- see the pin's own comment in pyproject.toml. Every bump needs a supply-chain re-audit of the diff against the previous pin (no new network hosts, no new eval/exec/base64/subprocess/pickle), which no bot can assert. Excluding it entirely made those updates INVISIBLE, which is not the same as safe -- a fork going unmaintained, or shipping a fix this collector needs, would simply never surface. dependencyDashboardApproval makes Renovate report the update and wait: ticking the box is the deliberate act that starts the audit, so the bump can never arrive looking like a routine one. Remove this rule entirely to make it fully automatic.

The Azure image pin automerges at any time, because merging it IS the deploy: the push to main triggers azure-deploy, which plans and then applies through the release-apply job only when scripts/azure_release_guard.py accepts the plan. The guard accepts nothing but an in-place update of all nine jobs whose sole difference is the container image, identical across jobs, equal to this pin and an exact release tag or digest, with nothing unknown until apply, and then waits until no job is running or about to fire. A plan with any other change, or a partial bump, is refused and the run fails: use the manual plan/apply path. CI must pass before Renovate merges. Schedule activation is not part of this; it stays an explicit variable change. Remove this rule to go back to merging pin PRs by hand (a merged pin still deploys).

Group workflow action bumps. The four actions in release.yml/pr-summary.yml move together and a split would mean several near-identical PRs against one file. Matches the homelab repo's own grouping of .github/workflows/**.

Group the news-site Worker toolchain. prettier and wrangler are one subtree's devDependencies with their own Node toolchain (CLAUDE.md's Conventions: npm/prettier/node --test, NOT ruff/pytest), and a bump to either is verified by the same `cd workers/news-site && npm ci && npm test` run -- so one PR, one verification.

A prettier major can reformat files it did not otherwise touch, and this subtree's test suite byte-compares rendered output against committed goldens -- so a prettier major is a review event, not a routine bump. Kept separate from the group above so its diff is read on its own.
